title: Oops all Beds
body:
You thought you were placing a furnace? **WRONG**. It’s a bed now.

Welcome to Oops All Beds — the mod that turns your beautiful Minecraft world into a surreal nightmare of cozy slumber. Any block you try to place may instead become a bed. A randomly colored one. And yes, it’s a full bed. Foot and head. No half measures here.

This mod is a fever dream brought to life. A comedy of errors in quilted form. A woolen virus for the world.

## **Features**

- Replaces placed blocks with a random bed. Seriously. You place dirt— you get a pink bed. Why? Because I said so 
- Blocks in the way? Obliterated. If another block dares to stand where the bed will go, it gets deleted without mercy. Not dropped. Not replaced. Just gone. 
- EVERYTHING is optional. What block gets placed/replaced? What direction the beds get placed. If you ask for more stuff, I'll add it if I find it funny enough.

## **Configuration**

**Whitelist mode**

_"whitelist": false_ 
If set to true only blocks listed in "whitelistBlocks" **WILL** be replaced.

If false then blocks listed in "blacklistBlocks" **WILL NOT** be replaced.

**Beds mode**

_"useBeds": true_

If set to false you can use the _"bedReplacements"_ list to add Custom blocks.

**Facing based Rotation**

_"placeBedFacingPlayer": false_

If set to false it will place the beds in Random rotations.
